diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in 'false' for every content check (C1-C6), meaning no agent was able to satisfy the requirements even when they had access to the necessary private facts. The model consistently defaulted to the initial draft values (e.g., 1.5-times extended time, small-group room) rather than updating them based on the hidden information in PF1 and PF2.
